source: UBS Global Wealth Report 2026 (data year 2025), global wealth pyramid. Band boundaries (adults) and the $100k-$1M and Over-$1M wealth shares are drawn directly from figures UBS published and multiple outlets reported (e.g. 'just over 41%' of adults under $10,000; 628 million adults / $184tn / 39.2% of wealth in the $100k-$1M band; 1.5% of adults are dollar-millionaires holding about 48% of wealth). The $10k-$100k and Under-$10k wealth shares are our own residual estimate that makes the four bands sum to 100% of adults and 100% of wealth, since we could not verify those two figures directly. Figures are approximate and rounded.
